headline: Birla AI Labs releases Yug-1, a time series foundation model
quote: has released Yug-1, its first time series foundation model (TSFM), developed to forecast outcomes, identify patterns, and detect anomalies across interconnected datasets.
claim: Birla AI Labs, an AI initiative and venture studio under the Aditya Birla Group, has released Yug-1, its first time series foundation model, which AIM reported on 19 Oct 2026 is available on GitHub and Hugging Face for developers and researchers to test. Founder and chairperson Ananya Birla says Yug-1 outperformed other first-generation time series models on the GiftEval benchmark and performed competitively against newer-generation models (the lab's own claim).
why_it_matters: A forecasting model from an Indian lab that you can test from GitHub or Hugging Face for demand or sensor-data projects; the benchmark claims are the company's own.
title: Birla AI Labs Launches Yug-1, a Time Series Foundation Model Built in India

headline: Chariot launches Chariot-1-ASR Realtime speech model for 10 Indian languages
quote: launched Chariot-1-ASR Realtime on October 22, a speech recognition model that converts spoken words into text
claim: Chariot, which AIM calls a frontier AI research lab, launched Chariot-1-ASR Realtime on 22 Oct 2026, a speech recognition model for 10 Indian languages plus Indian English that is available on the Chariot platform. In its own tests on 79 public test sets, Chariot says the model made 26% fewer errors than Google Gemini 3.5 Transcribe and 9% fewer than Sarvam's Saaras v4 against systems that process a whole recording, and 17% fewer than Saaras v4 against streaming systems.
why_it_matters: A speech-to-text model for Hindi and nine other Indian languages that claims fewer errors than Sarvam's Saaras v4; worth benchmarking yourself, since the results are Chariot's own.
title: How Does Chariot's Speech Recognition Compare?

headline: ElevenLabs' Karnataka voice-AI MoU draws pushback from Indian startups
quote: ElevenLabs recently signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS)
claim: AIM reported on 19 Oct 2026 that ElevenLabs recently signed an MoU with the Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS) to explore Kannada voice AI across citizen services, skilling and grievance redressal. Executives at Maya Research, Navana.ai and CoRover.ai are quoted criticising the choice of a foreign vendor for government services, citing exposure of citizen data to foreign jurisdictions and the credibility Indian firms lose.
why_it_matters: Public contracts are a key market for voice AI; Indian startups say losing them to foreign firms costs credibility with banks, insurers and departments.
title: Karnataka’s ElevenLabs Partnership Irks Indian Voice AI Startups

headline: Utho Cloud opens NVIDIA B300 GPU reservations in India for February 2027
quote: Indian cloud provider Utho Cloud has opened reservations for NVIDIA B300 GPUs in India ahead of a planned February 2027 deployment
claim: Utho Cloud, an Indian cloud provider, has opened reservations for NVIDIA B300 GPUs in India ahead of a planned February 2027 deployment (AIM, 19 Oct 2026); organisations can reserve capacity for one, two or three years, with rupee-based billing and India-hosted infrastructure. Utho has outlined plans to invest in and deploy 10,000 GPUs but gave no deployment timeline or count of B300 GPUs available for reservation.
why_it_matters: Multi-year, rupee-billed, India-hosted B300 reservations ahead of a planned February 2027 rollout; the report gives no price or GPU count, so it suits startups, not student projects.
title: Utho Cloud Opens B300 GPU Bookings Ahead of February 2027 Rollout

headline: Cortex DC plans 2 GW of AI-ready data centres across India
quote: the company plans to develop 2 gigawatts (GW) of capacity across India to meet rising demand for high-performance computing
claim: Cortex DC, the AI-first subsidiary of The Chatterjee Group, plans to develop 2 gigawatts of data centre capacity across India, is targeting operational readiness for its first data centre within 18 months of first shovel, and plans to source 51 per cent of its energy from green sources (Indian Infrastructure, 23 Oct 2026). The report names no site, investment figure or customer.
why_it_matters: A new entrant's 2 GW plan for Indian AI data centres: intent, not capacity yet, with no site, cost or customer named in the report.
title: Cortex DC advances plans to develop 2 GW of AI-ready data centre capacity across India - Indian Infrastructure
